Welcome to the FISH 470 Lab page! Here you can find various learning modules designed to help you enhance your skills in data analysis and visualization using R and the tidyverse. Each module includes background information, step-by-step instructions, and practical exercises to reinforce your learning. Reference these pages in concert with the Canvas course site for the learning materials for FISH 470 Lab.
